ICT defers charge framing against 2 Netrakona 'Razakars'
2015-02-16T00:00:48+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/ict-defers-charge-framing-against-2-netrakona-razakars-65077

The International Crimes Tribunal-1 yesterday deferred passing order on charge framing in the war crimes case against alleged Razakars of Netrakona -- Obaidul Haque alias Taher and Ataur Rahman alias Noni.

The tribunal fixed March 2 for passing order.

The three-member tribunal led by Justice M Enayetur Rahim had fixed yesterday to pass order, but said they want to look over documents again.

The tribunal on December 11, 2014 took the charges into cognisance against the two alleged Razakars.

According to the formal charge submitted by the prosecution, the two were involved in the abduction and killing of at least 15 persons and looting and setting fire to between 400 and 450 houses in 1971.

The prosecution said the duo led Razakars, an auxiliary force of the Pakistani occupation army, in the abduction of one Fazlur Rahman Talukder from Baushi Bazar on August 17, 1971. They later killed him in Trimohoni Bazar.

Obaidul and Ataur abducted acclaimed footballer Dabir Hossain from Barhatta and shot him dead at Moktarpara Bridge after torture, the formal charge reads. They also abducted 10 persons from Barhatta on October 12, 1971 and among them seven were shot dead. On November 15, 1971, they abducted another six and shot them dead.
